newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU summit approves stability pact, jobs deal.
newsitem.headline: EU summit approves stability pact, jobs deal.

text.p: European Union leaders on Monday approved a controversial budget stability pact and a resolution on boosting employment and growth hammered out by finance ministers, Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok said.

"It is with a great feeling of satisfaction that I can tell you the European Council has just reached complete agreement on what our finance ministers decided earlier," Kok told a news conference on the first day of a two-day summit.

The accord lifted one of the main obstacles to progress at a two-day summit of EU leaders, defusing what had threatened to be a serious rift between Bonn and Paris, the bloc's twin economic and political powerhouses.
